component.name: Globulation 2
component.summary: Real time strategy with automatic unit task assignment

description.p: Globulation 2 is a real time strategy game that lets players assign units to tasks instead of directing each unit individually. Play against computer opponents, edit maps, or play with others over a local network.

screenshot.caption: An AI-controlled colony with active buildings and units

description.p: Refreshed terrain and animated units; a redesigned map editor with touch controls; shared JavaScript map generators and online creation studios for maps, buildings, terrain, resources, music and colony skins; and complete translations.

Normal simulation now runs at 30 ticks per second, with deterministic scheduling and resource growth. Older saves remain supported through versioned migrations. Replays and multiplayer require matching compatible versions.
Packaging update for 0.10.0: Linux, Snap, Flatpak, RPM and Amazon Fire tablet builds.

Online play on the Globulation 2 platform with quick match, rooms and ratings; the Hive Mind commander; custom JavaScript AIs; farm areas as an experiment; match recording; redesigned game rules and end-of-game statistics; interface themes; and complete translations.
Prepare the three-architecture F-Droid Android release.
Prepare updated Windows desktop packaging and refresh the loading wordmark.
